summary: Comprehensive testing of Breamway Auto Transport CRM major rewrite. All backend tests passed (19/19). Frontend tests verified login, dashboard with 39,792 quotes, quotes page with BR format IDs, search/filter, Quick View modal, Convert to Order, Orders page, Quote Detail (create/edit), and 3 shipping types. Fixed one bug in QuoteDetail.js for /quotes/new route.

minor.issue: MongoDB index conflict on startup when sparse option differs from existing index - required manual index drop to fix
minor.resolution: Dropped conflicting indexes (quote_number_1, order_number_1) and restarted backend

backend: Login with valid credentials (shumail.s / HONDA@2026) returns 200 with token
Dashboard stats returns correct data (39,792 total quotes)
GET /api/quotes returns paginated results with BR format IDs
Search quotes by customer name works
Search quotes by phone number works
POST /api/quotes creates new quote with BR format ID
POST /api/quotes/{id}/convert-to-order creates order with ORD format ID
Double conversion correctly rejected with 400 error
GET /api/orders/{id} returns single order with all embedded data
PUT /api/orders/{id} updates order status through all stages
frontend: Login page loads with Shumail Technologies branding
Login with valid credentials redirects to dashboard
Dashboard shows 39,792 total quotes
Dashboard shows conversion rate, revenue, recent quotes
Sidebar navigation shows: Dashboard, Quotes, Orders, Invoices, Users, Settings
Quotes page loads 100 records with pagination (39,792 total)
Quotes table shows: Quote ID (BR format), Agent, Customer, Phone, Email, Vehicle, Pickup, Delivery, Price, Status
Search quotes by customer name works
Filter quotes by status works
Quick View modal opens and shows all quote details
Quick View shows customer, vehicle, addresses, price, shipping type
Vehicle link in table has onclick handler for Google Images
Convert to Order button creates order from quote
Orders page shows newly created order with all data carried over
Order detail page shows customer info, vehicle, dispatch fields
Order status can be updated via dropdown
New Quote page loads via /quotes/new route (after fix)
Quote creation works with all fields
Quote detail page shows View Vehicle button
Quote detail page has 3 shipping types: Standard, Expedited, Enclosed

critical_code_review_comments: Fixed bug in QuoteDetail.js: isNew check was 'id === "new"' but /quotes/new route doesn't pass id param, changed to '!id || id === "new"'
MongoDB index creation on startup can fail if index exists with different options - consider using try/catch or checking existing indexes first
seed_data_creation: No new seed data - used existing 39,792 imported quotes
context_for_next_testing_agent: CRM major rewrite is complete and working. 39,792 quotes with BR format IDs (BR000001-BR039792). Quote to Order conversion creates ORD format IDs. All CRUD operations working. Fixed QuoteDetail.js for /quotes/new route. MongoDB indexes were recreated after conflict resolution.
